CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_BLACKLIST_MST blacklist WHERE blacklist.BLACK_YN = 'Y' AND ( ( COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(blacklist.BLACK_USER_CONTACT, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', ''), '') != '' AND COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TB_RESEARCH_APP.APP_HPHONE, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', ''), '') != '' AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(blacklist.BLACK_USER_CONTACT, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', '') = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TB_RESEARCH_APP.APP_HPHONE, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', '') ) OR ( COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(blacklist.BLACK_USER_CONTACT, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', ''), '') != '' AND COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TB_RESEARCH_APP.APP_TELE, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', ''), '') != '' AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(blacklist.BLACK_USER_CONTACT, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', '') = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TB_RESEARCH_APP.APP_TELE, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', '') ) OR ( COALESCE(blacklist.BLACK_USER_NAME, '') != '' AND COALESCE(TB_RESEARCH_APP.APP_NAME, '') != '' AND COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(blacklist.BLACK_USER_BIRTH, '-', ''), '.', ''), '') != '' AND COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TB_RESEARCH_APP.APP_BIRTH, '-', ''), '.', ''), '') != '' AND blacklist.BLACK_USER_NAME = TB_RESEARCH_APP.APP_NAME AND REPLACE(REPLACE(blacklist.BLACK_USER_BIRTH, '-', ''), '.', '') = REPLACE(REPLACE(TB_RESEARCH_APP.APP_BIRTH, '-', ''), '.', '') ) ) ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS BLACKLIST_YN
mapper.select:
SELECT ,
FROM TB_RESEARCH_APP WHERE RESEARCH_NO = #{researchNo} AND RESEARCH_APP_SEQ = #{researchAppSeq} ORDER BY MODIFY_DT DESC, REGIST_DT DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ,
FROM TB_RESEARCH_APP WHERE RESEARCH_NO = #{researchNo} ORDER BY RESEARCH_APP_SEQ DESC

SELECT ,
FROM TB_RESEARCH_APP ORDER BY REGIST_DT DESC, RESEARCH_APP_SEQ DESC

SELECT ,
FROM TB_RESEARCH_APP WHERE LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(REGIST_DT AS CHAR), '[^0-9]', ''), 8) >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), '%Y%m%d') ORDER BY REGIST_DT DESC, RESEARCH_APP_SEQ DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT ,
FROM TB_RESEARCH_APP WHERE RESEARCH_NO = #{researchNo} AND COALESCE(PROVIDE_YN, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY RESEARCH_APP_SEQ ASC

SELECT app.RESEARCH_APP_SEQ FROM TB_RESEARCH_APP app WHERE app.RESEARCH_NO = #{researchNo} AND COALESCE(app.PROVIDE_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_BLACKLIST_MST blacklist WHERE blacklist.BLACK_YN = 'Y' AND ( ( COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(blacklist.BLACK_USER_CONTACT, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', ''), '') != '' AND COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(app.APP_HPHONE, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', ''), '') != '' AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(blacklist.BLACK_USER_CONTACT, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', '') = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(app.APP_HPHONE, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', '') ) OR ( COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(blacklist.BLACK_USER_CONTACT, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', ''), '') != '' AND COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(app.APP_TELE, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', ''), '') != '' AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(blacklist.BLACK_USER_CONTACT, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', '') = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(app.APP_TELE, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', '') ) OR ( COALESCE(blacklist.BLACK_USER_NAME, '') != '' AND COALESCE(app.APP_NAME, '') != '' AND COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(blacklist.BLACK_USER_BIRTH, '-', ''), '.', ''), '') != '' AND COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(app.APP_BIRTH, '-', ''), '.', ''), '') != '' AND blacklist.BLACK_USER_NAME = app.APP_NAME AND REPLACE(REPLACE(blacklist.BLACK_USER_BIRTH, '-', ''), '.', '') = REPLACE(REPLACE(app.APP_BIRTH, '-', ''), '.', '') ) ) ) ORDER BY app.RESEARCH_APP_SEQ ASC

SELECT RESEARCH_NO, RESEARCH_APP_SEQ, COUNT(*) AS DUPLICATE_COUNT, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(APP_NAME, '') ORDER BY APP_NAME SEPARATOR ', ') AS APP_NAMES, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(APP_HPHONE, '') ORDER BY APP_HPHONE SEPARATOR ', ') AS APP_HPHONES, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(APP_BIRTH, '') ORDER BY APP_BIRTH SEPARATOR ', ') AS APP_BIRTHS, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(PROVIDE_YN, '') ORDER BY PROVIDE_YN SEPARATOR ', ') AS PROVIDE_YNS, MIN(REGIST_DT) AS FIRST_REGIST_DT, MAX(MODIFY_DT) AS LAST_MODIFY_DT FROM TB_RESEARCH_APP WHERE RESEARCH_NO = #{researchNo} GROUP BY RESEARCH_NO, RESEARCH_APP_SEQ HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DUPLICATE_COUNT DESC, RESEARCH_APP_SEQ DESC

SELECT ,
FROM TB_RESEARCH_APP WHERE RESEARCH_NO = #{researchNo} AND RESEARCH_APP_SEQ IN
#{researchAppSeq}
ORDER BY RESEARCH_APP_SEQ DESC

SELECT ,
FROM TB_RESEARCH_APP WHERE RESEARCH_NO = #{researchNo} AND COALESCE(PROVIDE_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND RESEARCH_APP_SEQ IN
#{researchAppSeq}
ORDER BY RESEARCH_APP_SEQ DESC

SELECT RESEARCH_APP_SEQ FROM TB_RESEARCH_APP WHERE RESEARCH_NO = #{researchNo} AND APP_NAME = #{appName} AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(APP_HPHONE, ''), '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', '') = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(#{appHphone}, ''), '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', '') ORDER BY RESEARCH_APP_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT app.RESEARCH_NO, app.RESEARCH_APP_SEQ, research.RESEARCH_TITLE, app.APP_NAME, app.APP_BIRTH, app.APP_HPHONE, app.APP_JOB, app.APP_COMPANY, app.PROVIDE_YN, app.REGIST_DT FROM TB_RESEARCH_APP app LEFT JOIN TB_RESEARCH_MST research ON research.RESEARCH_NO = app.RESEARCH_NO WHERE COALESCE(#{appName}, '') != '' AND COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{appBirth}, '-', ''), '.', ''), '') != '' AND app.APP_NAME = #{appName} AND REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(app.APP_BIRTH, ''), '-', ''), '.', '') = REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(#{appBirth}, ''), '-', ''), '.', '') AND ( ( COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{appHphone}, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', ''), '') != '' AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(app.APP_HPHONE, ''), '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', '') = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(#{appHphone}, ''), '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', '') ) OR ( COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{appTele}, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', ''), '') != '' AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(app.APP_TELE, ''), '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', '') = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(#{appTele}, ''), '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', '') ) ) ORDER BY app.REGIST_DT DESC, app.RESEARCH_NO DESC, app.RESEARCH_APP_SEQ DESC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(RESEARCH_APP_SEQ), 0) + 1 FROM TB_RESEARCH_APP
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_RESEARCH_APP ( RESEARCH_NO, RESEARCH_APP_SEQ, APP_NAME, APP_SEX, APP_BIRTH, APP_AGE, APP_JOB, APP_COMPANY, APP_HPHONE, APP_TELE, APP_ADDR, ADD_COMMENT, ATTEND_RESEARCH, PROVIDE_YN, REGIST_DT, MODIFY_DT ) VALUES ( #{researchNo}, #{researchAppSeq}, #{appName}, #{appSex}, #{appBirth}, #{appAge}, #{appJob}, #{appCompany}, #{appHphone}, #{appTele}, #{appAddr}, #{addComment}, #{attendResearch}, #{provideYn}, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_RESEARCH_MST SET APP_CNT = COALESCE(APP_CNT, 0) + 1, APP_NEW_CNT = COALESCE(APP_NEW_CNT, 0) + 1, MODIFY_DT = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') WHERE RESEARCH_NO = #{researchNo}
